decision: Documented Access setup, token lifecycle, usage filters, and the Cho-specific Bearer/OAuth limitation

decision: Used `jose` with Web Crypto and `createRemoteJWKSet` instead of manual JWT parsing

decision: Added inclusive UTC `from` and `to` filters and per-tool totals to the owner-scoped usage response

decision: Removed owner subject and secret hash from token-list summaries

decision: Added an exact Origin rejection case while retaining the no-Origin MCP request case

decision: Scoped Hono CORS to /api/mcp behind an exact-Origin guard
why: Browser clients need preflight and exposed MCP headers, while no-Origin clients remain native; a route-local guard rejects unlisted origins for every method without app-wide CORS
